naics_2022_mapping.description: Common NAICS 2022 industry codes for discovery queries. Use with industries.industryCode filter and pair with industries.industryType = 'naics_2022_code'

Food & Beverage.722515: Snack and Nonalcoholic Beverage Bars (coffee shops, juice bars)
Food & Beverage.722410: Drinking Places (Alcoholic Beverages) - bars, taverns, nightclubs

Retail.445110: Supermarkets and Other Grocery (except Convenience) Stores

Automotive.811121: Automotive Body, Paint, and Interior Repair and Maintenance
Automotive.811191: Automotive Oil Change and Lubrication Shops

Healthcare.621111: Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists)
Healthcare.621112: Offices of Physicians, Mental Health Specialists
Healthcare.621330: Offices of Mental Health Practitioners (except Physicians)
Healthcare.621340: Offices of Physical, Occupational and Speech Therapists, and Audiologists
Healthcare.621420: Outpatient Mental Health and Substance Abuse Centers
Healthcare.621493: Freestanding Ambulatory Surgical and Emergency Centers
Healthcare.621999: All Other Miscellaneous Ambulatory Health Care Services
Healthcare.622310: Specialty (except Psychiatric and Substance Abuse) Hospitals
Healthcare.623210: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability Facilities
Healthcare.623220: Residential Mental Health and Substance Abuse Facilities
Healthcare.623312: Assisted Living Facilities for the Elderly

Professional Services.541611: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
Professional Services.541614: Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services

Personal Services.812199: Other Personal Care Services (spas, tanning salons, etc.)

Construction.236115: New Single-Family Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders)
Construction.236116: New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders)
Construction.237110: Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction
Construction.237120: Oil and Gas Pipeline and Related Structures Construction
Construction.237130: Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction
Construction.237990: Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction

Finance & Insurance.522320: Financial Transactions Processing, Reserve, and Clearinghouse Activities
Finance & Insurance.522390: Other Activities Related to Credit Intermediation
Finance & Insurance.524114: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers
Finance & Insurance.524126: Direct Property and Casualty Insurance Carriers
Finance & Insurance.524128: Other Direct Insurance (except Life, Health, and Medical) Carriers
Finance & Insurance.524292: Third Party Administration of Insurance and Pension Funds

Real Estate.531110: Lessors of Residential Buildings and Dwellings
Real Estate.531130: Lessors of Miniwarehouses and Self-Storage Units
Real Estate.531190: Lessors of Other Real Estate Property
Real Estate.531210: Offices of Real Estate Agents and Brokers
Real Estate.531390: Other Activities Related to Real Estate

notes: This is a focused subset of commonly-used NAICS codes. The full NAICS 2022 has 1000+ codes.
Always pair industryCode filter with industryType = 'naics_2022_code'
For semantic discovery, use 'prompt' instead of NAICS codes (more user-friendly)
NAICS codes are 6 digits and should be strings in filters (e.g., '722515' not 722515)
